chapters.label: Extra time, live
chapters.text: Moscow, 2008, in the rain. Champions League final, extra time. Patrice Evra dances down the left and pulls it back. Ryan Giggs shoots over the keeper... John Terry heads it off the line!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Terry was caught on the wrong foot, but he never gives up. He races back to the line, stays on his feet and stretches up. Header, behind for a corner!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn. When your keeper is beaten, get back between the ball and the goal. Stay on your feet and be brave!
